intent: bounded Object-owned serviceability contract proving that the existing asymmetric registration datum does not consume the existing four fastener-axis clearance reservations on either bilateral service socket

clearance_contract.section: local lateral/up interface plane normal to each source-owned socket axis
requirements: every reserved fastener-axis circle remains strictly inside both host and module interface footprints
reserved fastener-axis circles remain mutually non-overlapping
the host registration pin and module registration recess remain strictly outside every reserved fastener-axis circle
the same local clearance relations reproduce on both exact bilateral source frames
clearance_contract.fallback: fail closed; do not move a fastener, registration datum, socket frame or footprint to manufacture a pass

provenance.method: AXM self-authored deterministic hard-surface serviceability proof over existing exact Object sources

truth_boundary: This contract proves only source-space planar separation between the existing reserved fastener-axis clearance circles, interface footprint edges, and the exact registration pin/recess datum. It does not prove an actual fastener head, driver/tool envelope, threaded retention, hole fabrication, blind-recess manufacturability, tolerance stack, load, wear, sealing, full-mesh collision, runtime attachment, physics, gameplay, final topology/materials, visual acceptance, CANON or production readiness.
